parsed.why: Self-ID and equal-treatment law; frictions are airport screening, sauna operator rules and binary prison placement if detained — real but mitigable exposures in a protective, functioning legal system.

No protections, no recognition, police dismiss anti-trans violence ('two men'), documented impunity and 4x assault risk; decriminalisation and improving institutional dialogue temper but don't offset.

Enforced Sharia code criminalising same-sex conduct (lashes, 8 years), documented private-home arrest, hostile UPR posture, no recourse; resort isolation offers partial shield only, unresolved legal ambiguity for trans visitors.

Explicit anti-discrimination law, border explicitly accepts trans passports and X markers, working police recording; detention placement ungoverned and rising incident reports reduce from low-risk band.

Organised state targeting: sodomy executions, custodial rape, forced surgery pressure, official exclusion of trans people from public space, raids and pretext charges — near-certain severe state consequences if outed.
